basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original elementary student expression-pair sprite for review window in a children's educational game. Reference 1 is APPROVED STYLE: match drawing language of faces, thin dark navy outline, soft painted hand-drawn shading, warm storybook colors, scale and proportions. Reference 2 robot is ONLY for thin line weight. References 3/4/5 show existing shop customers and previous 12 students: new student must be clearly distinct from everyone there, especially when viewed WAIST UP, by face shape/features, hair silhouette/shade and top. Retain warm hand-drawn textbook quality, never copy known textbook characters. Canvas 908x680 landscape with genuine transparent alpha, EXACTLY TWO full-body copies of same student side by side, centered in equal 454px halves. Both stand naturally relaxed, body and gaze slightly turned to viewer's RIGHT. Children about FIVE heads tall (head including hair roughly one fifth height), not chibi, never adult. Grades 3/4 younger, grades 5/6 somewhat taller. Small top margin, complete shoes on same baseline at bottom edge without clipping. LEFT face: politely and slightly shyly waiting for a form check, calm gentle uncertainty, closed mouth or tiny gentle smile; NOT sad, scared, distressed. RIGHT face: warm happy smile after a good answer. CRITICAL identical pose, body silhouette, clothing folds, hands, hairstyle, size, relative placement, props, line weight and shading in both halves; ONLY eyebrows/eyes/mouth expression changes. Empty-handed unless subject explicitly lists backpack. Do not add papers, books, phones, toys or bags. No text, labels, letters, numbers, divider, ground shadow, background or extra people. Never orange hoodie with spiky hair, never ponytail plus green/cream stripes.
